title: Have bytesval_to_str(_wmem) and rval_to_str(_wmem) require memory scope
description:
1. bytesval_to_str (now bytesval_to_str_wmem to match other APIs)
2. bytesprefix_to_str
3. rval_to_str (now rval_to_str_wmem)

   have added a wmem_allocator_t\* argument so they don't need to use wmem_packet_scope
